description:
## Goal

Describe the compiler by its current authorities instead of by a deleted predecessor, and remove tests that can only fail if deleted modules are reintroduced.

## Current proof

The old compiler, planner, type-infer pipeline, REPL front door, and fz wrapper are absent. .agent/docs/compiler2-migration.md still says migration remains and contains mutually incompatible fixture-status snapshots. Compiler and CLI tests repeatedly assert that planner, type_infer, or frontend telemetry is absent even though those emitters and modules no longer exist. Public help still calls fz2 side-by-side.

## Strategy

Inventory every unique still-true invariant in the migration document and move only missing durable facts into the owning pipeline, fact-engine, fixture, module, or telemetry document. Add or retain positive assertions at current artifact and telemetry boundaries. Delete the migration document, impossible negative helpers and calls, and side-by-side wording. Do not rename the public binary or compiler module in this ticket. Do not retain history as comments.

## Signal

No active documentation is organized around migration from the deleted compiler. Repository search finds no old-pipeline absence helper or side-by-side claim. Current positive behavior, artifact, and telemetry assertions remain. Documentation references resolve; full library, CLI, and fixture-matrix tests, formatting, workspace checks, and strict clippy pass.

## Deletion

Delete the migration document after relocation, negative-only helper functions and invocations, and obsolete cutover wording. Port-prefixed test files are not deleted here because their behavioral uniqueness requires a separate census.
title: Retire the completed Compiler2 migration narrative and impossible old-pipeline sentinels
